blocks.text: Surveys collect large amounts of data in a structured way by asking a sample group a predefined set of questions, through online forms, telephone calls or face-to-face interviews. A small grocery store in Islamabad asks 50 customers over a weekend five questions: which product categories they buy most often, which products they would like to see more often, how often they shop there, what most influences their purchases (price, quality or availability), and any other comments. The answers help it stock what customers want.

blocks.prompt: Give one advantage and one limitation of surveys.
blocks.explanation: Advantage: many responses quickly in a comparable form. Limitation: people may answer carelessly or not honestly, and only those who respond are counted. The limitation is general knowledge.

items: Surveys: set questions to a sample (online, phone, face to face); e.g. 50 grocery customers.
